alt: 左邊園丁放好胡蘿蔔和敞開的提籠後退開，讓兔子自行靠近；右邊兔子已進籠吃蘿蔔，園丁輕輕關上籠門。
scene_prompt: A clear TWO-panel wordless sequence of a kind gardener strategically recovering a shy escaped pet rabbit. Left panel: gardener deliberately sets an open carrot basket on the grass, places a roomy open pet carrier beside it, then steps far back with relaxed open hands so the wary rabbit feels free to approach. Right panel: the same rabbit has voluntarily hopped into the carrier to eat the carrots, and the gardener calmly closes its door while smiling. Clearly show initial deliberate loosening of control as a tactic followed by safe successful recovery; rabbit unharmed, no chase, no trap injury, no arrows or text.
